title: This repository adopts the SGPS Agent Memory Graph (AMG 1.0, Graphiti)
body: Agent memory for this repository is the append-only episode log docs/memory/episodes.jsonl. Graphiti builds a derived temporal graph from it in an embedded FalkorDB Lite file outside the repository. Extraction runs on the FinOps ladder free, then Go, then Claude API; embeddings run locally. Memory is recall, never authorization; the repository wins on conflict.
author: owner
